title: Changes to Route 536
articleDescription: On 26 July 2026, we’re improving Route 536 by adding more services, extending operating hours and making the route path the same for every trip
articleContent:
To plan your journey:

  • Download the PTV App
  • Use the journey planner
  • Check the Route 536 timetable
  • or call 1800 800 007.

New Sunday trips 

  • We’re adding Sunday services to Route 536 for the first time.
  • Route 536 will run 44 trips on Sundays.
  • Sunday services will run from 6:41 am to 9:49 pm.
  • Sunday services will come every 40 minutes for most of the day.

Times indicate the departure of the first and last service.

Timetable changes

  • We’re adding 115 new weekly trips to Route 536, including 44 trips on Sundays.
  • Route 536 will run later every day of the week.
  • Weekday and Saturday services will run later to 11 pm.
  • Weekday morning trips will start earlier. You can transfer from Route 536 to a train at Glenroy Station, arriving at Flinders Street Station before 6:30 am.
  • Route 536 will operate on all public holidays for the first time.

Route and stop changes 

  • We’re removing the mid route split on Route 536.
  • Currently, Route 536 splits mid-way through its journey alternating between two route paths in Glenroy.
  • This split will be removed to make the route and timetable simpler and easier to understand.
  • All Route 536 trips will travel along Hilton Street, May Street, Evell Street, Morley Street and Daley Street.
  • Route 536 will no longer travel on parts of Hilton Street and Morely Street. It will be removed from Bourchier Street.
  • Seven stops on Bourchier Street, Morley Street and Daley Street will close.
  • Passengers on the removed section of the route can walk up to 370 meters to alternative bus stops.
  • The second last stop on Route 536 will no longer be serviced by Route 536.
  • The stop is located on Sages Road near Gowrie Station (stop ID 40355).
  • The route will be renamed Route 536 Glenroy Station – Gowrie Station.

Closed and alternative stops 

Closed stops

  • Morley St/Daley St (stop ID 46019)
  • Daley St/Morley St (stop ID 7501)
  • Everard St/Morley St (stop ID 7626)
  • West St/Bourchier St (stop ID 7627)
  • West St/Bourchier St (stop ID 7502)
  • Hilton St/Bourchier St (stop ID 7628)
  • Hilton St/Bourchier St (stop ID 7503).

Alternative stops

  • Justin Ave/Daley St (stop IDs 7621 & 7496)
  • Morley St/Evell St (stop IDs 7497 & 7622)
  • West St/Evell St (stop IDs 7498 & 7623)
  • Sadie St/Evell St (stop IDs 7624 & 7499)
  • May St/Evell St (stop IDs 7500 & 7625).


Passengers should check the new Route 536 map and timetable and plan ahead before travelling.
